title: Input.is_mouse_button_pressed not working for Extra Side Buttons
body:
### Tested versions

4.6 stable windows 11 x86

### System information

Godot v4.6.stable - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Direct3D 12 (Mobile) - dedicated AMD Radeon(TM) Graphics (Advanced Micro Devices, Inc.; 32.0.21037.1004) - AMD Ryzen 7 6800U with Radeon Graphics (16 threads) - 12.74 GiB memory

### Issue description

I was just trying to read the side mouse buttons like this inside my _physics_process:
`Input.is_mouse_button_pressed(MOUSE_BUTTON_XBUTTON1)`
but it always returns **false** except for main buttons (left/right/middle)

**the _input function prints the side button's event.button_index correctly.**
signals on ui nodes seems to respond correctly too.

Minimal reproduction:
```
func _input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
	if event is InputEventMouseButton:
		print(event.button_index)

func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
	printt(Input.is_mouse_button_pressed(MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT), Input.is_mouse_button_pressed(MOUSE_BUTTON_RIGHT), Input.is_mouse_button_pressed(MOUSE_BUTTON_MIDDLE), Input.is_mouse_button_pressed(MOUSE_BUTTON_XBUTTON1), Input.is_mouse_button_pressed(MOUSE_BUTTON_XBUTTON2))


```

### Steps to reproduce

use a mouse with more than 3 buttons and click anywhere with all buttons
regular buttons work everywhere
side buttons (MOUSE_BUTTON_XBUTTON1 and MOUSE_BUTTON_XBUTTON2, indexes 8 and 9) works on _input as event but not by querying Input.is_mouse_button_pressed directly

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[sidemouse.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/26521226/sidemouse.zip)
